## SubsystemReadyQuery_004e18c0 — SubsystemReadyCheck

**Summary:** Queries readiness of subsystem indexed by a2 (0-13). Subsystems 0-3 checked via stride-296 array at offset 0x144, subsystems 4-5 via dedicated fields, subsystems 6-13 via stride-68 array at offset 0x4D4. Returns 1 if ready (pointer allocated AND ready byte zero), 0 otherwise. Initialization status query.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND  
**Call frequency:** UNKNOWN (no static path from tick root)

**Called by:** SetupCarLightingAndRender (004c71c0), EffectDataTableInitialization (004e1970)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| this | 0x5E4 | R | — | subsystem 4 pointer/bitmap, checked for non-zero |
| this | 0x624 | R | — | subsystem 4 ready byte, must be 0 |
| this | 0x628 | R | — | subsystem 5 pointer/bitmap, checked for non-zero |
| this | 0x668 | R | — | subsystem 5 ready byte, must be 0 |

**Globals referenced:**

| Address | Name | R/W | Role |
|---------|------|-----|------|
| 004e1948 | jpt_4E18D0 | R | jump table for switch on subsystem index |
| 004e1958 | byte_4E1958 | R | data following jump table (alignment/padding) |

**Functions called:**

| Address | Name | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|

**Guard conditions:** For subsystems 0-3 and 6-13: if pointer at computed offset is NULL OR ready byte at offset+64 is non-zero, return 0 (not ready). Otherwise return 1 (ready). For 4/5: if pointer is NULL OR dedicated ready byte non-zero, return 0. Default case returns 0.
